svg.title: Crusader Period · 1095–1291
svg.text: Red ring: a recorded siege in 1095–1291
Numbers link to the occupation / siege index
Dates describe selected phases, not continuous rule
No siege recorded ≠ proof of no siege
Mainland focus; Aegean and Egypt give context
